product_name: 水力发电大坝低空安全监测
summary_en: A low-altitude airspace monitoring, access-screening, and event-management solution for hydroelectric dams, reservoirs, spillways, powerhouses, transmission-interface zones, and critical access points. It focuses on early awareness, visual verification, environmental noise filtering, checkpoint coordination, and documented operator workflows for complex water conservancy and key-area security environments, without publishing controlled technical or site-specific details.
key_application_en: Hydroelectric dams, reservoirs, spillways, powerhouses, intake areas, perimeter roads, transmission-interface zones, guard posts, and personnel/material access points.
key_parameter_1: 环境适配感知：结合可见光、热成像、低空态势数据和人工复核，降低水面反光、雾雨、飞鸟和山体遮挡带来的误报。
key_parameter_1_en: Environmental Awareness: combines visual, thermal, low-altitude airspace data, and operator review to reduce false alarms from water reflection, fog, rain, birds, and terrain clutter.
key_parameter_1_ru: Адаптация к среде: визуальные, тепловизионные и низковысотные данные вместе с проверкой оператором снижают ложные тревоги от бликов воды, тумана, дождя, птиц и рельефа.
key_parameter_2_en: Layered Security Linkage: consolidates airspace alerts, video verification, access screening, materials inspection, handling status, and review materials for daily duty, patrol dispatch, and emergency coordination.

parameters_en.operation_upgrade_title: How Airspace Monitoring Supports Dam and Reservoir Security
parameters_en.solution_modules_intro: The solution references public critical-infrastructure and key-area security frameworks, organizing low-altitude monitoring, visual verification, access screening, alert documentation, and cross-team coordination for water conservancy power-generation sites. It does not publish controlled technical parameters, site layouts, or project-specific field details.
industry_pain_points: Dams, reservoirs, spillways, powerhouses, and surrounding slopes create complex terrain where fixed cameras can leave blind spots and manual patrols can be slow.
Water reflection, fog, rain, birds, and terrain clutter increase the difficulty of reliable low-altitude event verification when only one sensing method is used.

Hydroelectric stations are critical infrastructure where security, operations, inspection, access management, and emergency teams need a unified alert entry point, event status, and reviewable records.
Critical entrances, materials lanes, and guard posts need to coordinate with airspace monitoring so aerial alerts, personnel movement, and item inspection records do not remain fragmented.
uav_industry_upgrade: Low-altitude airspace monitoring and visual verification provide earlier awareness around dam bodies, reservoir banks, intake areas, powerhouse perimeters, and transmission-interface zones.
Multi-source data and operator review help filter natural environmental noise so duty teams can focus on events that need confirmation and coordination.
Access screening and materials inspection workflows add traceable records for personnel, vehicles, parcels, and tools entering sensitive operating areas.
The command platform preserves alerts, imagery, timelines, and handling status for patrol dispatch, operational coordination, shift handover, and post-event review.

solution_modules.description: Build a continuous monitoring view around dam bodies, reservoirs, powerhouses, perimeter roads, and transmission interfaces, showing event clues, location context, and alert levels.

solution_modules.description: Use visual and thermal imagery to support operator confirmation in fog, rain, low light, water reflection, and complex terrain backgrounds.

solution_modules.description: Coordinate personnel entrances, materials lanes, and guard posts with item inspection, electronic-device management, and passage records.

solution_modules.name: Command Platform Linkage
solution_modules.description: Route verified alerts to security, operations, inspection, and emergency teams with event status, handling notes, and cross-role coordination context.

solution_modules.name: Record Archive and Review
solution_modules.description: Archive tracks, snapshots, entrance exceptions, timestamps, and operator notes for shift handover, compliance review, and operational risk analysis.

detail_html_en:
Industry Pain Points

  • Dams, reservoirs, spillways, powerhouses, and surrounding slopes create complex terrain where fixed cameras can leave blind spots and manual patrols can be slow.
  • Water reflection, fog, rain, birds, and terrain clutter increase the difficulty of reliable low-altitude event verification when only one sensing method is used.
  • Hydroelectric stations are critical infrastructure where security, operations, inspection, access management, and emergency teams need a unified alert entry point, event status, and reviewable records.
  • Critical entrances, materials lanes, and guard posts need to coordinate with airspace monitoring so aerial alerts, personnel movement, and item inspection records do not remain fragmented.

Security Operation Upgrade

  • Low-altitude airspace monitoring and visual verification provide earlier awareness around dam bodies, reservoir banks, intake areas, powerhouse perimeters, and transmission-interface zones.
  • Multi-source data and operator review help filter natural environmental noise so duty teams can focus on events that need confirmation and coordination.
  • Access screening and materials inspection workflows add traceable records for personnel, vehicles, parcels, and tools entering sensitive operating areas.
  • The command platform preserves alerts, imagery, timelines, and handling status for patrol dispatch, operational coordination, shift handover, and post-event review.

Solution Modules

  • Low-Altitude Airspace Monitoring: Build a continuous monitoring view around dam bodies, reservoirs, powerhouses, perimeter roads, and transmission interfaces, showing event clues, location context, and alert levels.
  • Visual and Thermal Verification: Use visual and thermal imagery to support operator confirmation in fog, rain, low light, water reflection, and complex terrain backgrounds.
  • Access and Materials Screening: Coordinate personnel entrances, materials lanes, and guard posts with item inspection, electronic-device management, and passage records.
  • Command Platform Linkage: Route verified alerts to security, operations, inspection, and emergency teams with event status, handling notes, and cross-role coordination context.
  • Record Archive and Review: Archive tracks, snapshots, entrance exceptions, timestamps, and operator notes for shift handover, compliance review, and operational risk analysis.
